parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, clothing or facility ban, or documented police targeting, detention placement or visitor violence rate is documented, and consensual same-sex conduct was decriminalised in 1998. Against that, the December 2025 nationwide propaganda ban creates a new arrest/fine risk for public LGBTQ visibility, there are no documented anti-discrimination protections or hate-crime reporting/recourse mechanisms since 2018, and one 2023 bias incident drew no investigation. No documented social acceptance or working visitor remedy offsets these gaps. Thin data resolves below the acceptance-plus-remedy 0.65-0.75 tier but well above unremedied universal exclusion or organised targeting.

entry_documents.exposure: No clothing, facility or foreign-document rule documented; how foreign passports/markers are treated at entry is not documented.
entry_documents.protection: No trans-specific entry restriction documented in the dossier.
entry_documents.interaction: Propaganda law could interact with document/phone checks if visibility is treated as propaganda; no such enforcement documented.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Custody or detention placement for trans visitors not documented. Propaganda violations carry 10-day arrest and fine, enforcement against trans visitors not documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: If detained under propaganda law, placement and safeguards are unknown; do not infer safety from silence.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No toilet, bathroom or public-facility restriction by gender documented; no region-specific facility signal beyond resident commission access gap.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Absence of a documented facility ban is a protection against universal exposure.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: National propaganda ban applies nationwide and does not itself impose a facility rule.

care_services.exposure: Abstract regional health-right barriers noted; visitor emergency care, ward placement and medication access not documented.
care_services.protection: Not documented for visitors. Resident medicalised gender-recognition process is not a traveller protection.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: December 2025 law prohibits propaganda of non-traditional sexual orientation in public/media, 10-day arrest/fine; signed after petition/ministry review. Enforcement against trans expression not documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No presentation offence; same-sex conduct decriminalised 1998.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Law may chill visibility and be used by police, but dossier does not document that use against visitors.

minors_guardians.exposure: No visitor-specific rule for minors documented. Resident adoption/marriage bars do not directly govern a traveller with a minor; propaganda law application to minors not documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Uncertain whether travelling with a minor changes propaganda or document-check exposure.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: One 2023 incident: activist almost run over, no investigation opened. No trans-specific violence rate, pattern or police targeting documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: 2019 Supreme Court compensation for privacy violation after homophobic post; lesbian couple, not trans visitor, and they fled eight months fearing safety.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: No hate-crime data reported since 2018 and no National Point of Contact suggests bias incidents may go unrecorded or unremedied.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No anti-discrimination laws in employment, education, housing, health, public accommodations or credit documented; enforcement of 2025 propaganda law and outcomes for out-of-capital residents unresolved.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Court compensation in 2019 shows some privacy recourse existed, but no working visitor-facing equality remedy documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Absence of resident machinery is only a climate signal; absence of visitor remedy leaves new law and bias incidents without documented correction.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar dead-letter sexuality law and no targeting, but 0.65-C has documented traditional acceptance and a court compensation award; this dossier lacks documented trans acceptance and adds a new propaganda arrest law, so lower.

0.55-B has repeated documented hostile service refusals with partial mediation/police prosecution. This dossier has no such repeated visitor-service pattern, but has a new nationwide arrest law and weaker documented recourse, placing it near this level.

0.45-A has an unremedied universal birth-sex bathroom rule upheld by courts. This dossier documents no facility ban, no custody birth-sex rule and no organised targeting, so materially higher than 0.45.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime is nationwide: no trans-specific or facility criminalisation, but a fresh propaganda offence, no documented visitor protections, and thin bias-violence recourse interact so an outed visitor's main risks are public-visibility enforcement, unrecorded harassment and ineffective complaint routes, not imprisonment for presentation or mandatory birth-sex placement. Presence of a 2019 privacy remedy is positive but dated and non-trans-specific. Hence elevated-to-reduced borderline: documented legal threat without documented enforcement or acceptance.
